about: The `pages_read` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 6 of 7 for fy 2012.

rows.reconciliation: page 81, the row `Total General Government`: voted_fy2013 1,144,705.0 vs printed 1,144,705.0
rows.proof: `FY 2013 Omnibus Budget`, PDF pages 81-82 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 78-79 -- the budget Town Meeting VOTED under Article 8, printed inside the FY2012 report. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so it was read off the pages' own 518 dpi bitmaps; NO recognition was used. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `Line No.` | `Account` | `VOTED FY 2013`. ONE money column. `$  -` is the page's explicit zero and is recorded as 0.00. The line numbering runs 1 to 83 with 3A, 3B, 13A, 14A, 46A, 64A, 68A and 79A inserted and NO line 18 -- that is what the page prints. THIS IS A VOTE, NOT A LEDGER: `VOTED FY 2013` is what Town Meeting appropriated for the NEXT fiscal year, so it belongs to FY2013 and must never be added to the FY2012 appropriations schedule on pp.60-65, which reports what FY2012 spent. WHAT PROVES IT: the page prints a subtotal for every section and the lines foot to it exactly, section by section, with no tolerance declared. Each section is its own group in `page-reads/` so that each of those totals is a check a script runs rather than a sentence. THE TOWN'S OWN TOTAL DOES NOT FOOT, and that is attested rather than mended: the eleven printed section totals sum to 27,488,841.00 and `Total Omnibus` prints 27,489,441.00, SIX HUNDRED DOLLARS more. The reading is not in doubt -- every one of the eleven sections closes on its own printed subtotal from its own printed lines, which is eleven independent checks on the components, and `Total Omnibus` was re-read upright at full scale. WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: which figure is wrong. The $600 could be a line the page does not print, a section total understated, or the grand total overstated, and nothing on these two pages distinguishes them. Nothing here picks a digit to make it close (rule 14). SECTION: General Government.
